newsitem.title: LATVIA: Ventspils loadings resume, pipleline still shut.
newsitem.headline: Ventspils loadings resume, pipleline still shut.

text.p: Loadings of crude at the Latvian Baltic outlet of Ventspils were renewed on Thursday as fog lifted in the morning, port officials said.
But pipeline deliveries will not resume until Friday evening as Ventspils Nafta's reservoir capacity is being enlarged.
"Berthing can procede as normal as fog lifted in the morning," Ventspils port capitain Arvids Buks told Reuters.
"Two vessels, Yannis M and Natura, are currently being loaded," a Ventspils Nafta terminal spokesman said.
The two ships had been at anchor outside the terminal since Tuesday morning due to fog.
Crude deliveries will resume late on Friday. The pipeline has been closed since 23.50 (20.50 GMT) on Wednesday because the terminal's reservoir capacity is being enlarged, he added.
"We have an agreement with Latrostrans, the pipeline operator, for a 48 hour closure," the spokesman said.
